Messages.Author: cantila
Messages.Body:
Sorry if this has been answered before. For how long does the effect of
MRC last? If I calla vote and am unsuccessful can I keep calling till
I succeed and the MRC's effect will then kick in? Will MRC be "active"
for the rest of the game or does the vote have to be called the same
round as MRC is played?

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <90n44m$jad$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

cantila <rogc...@student.luth.se> wrote:
> For how long does the effect of MRC last?

One vote that you call.

It stays in play until you successfully call a vote,
then it is burned to make it pass automatically.

> If I calla vote and am unsuccessful can I keep calling till
> I succeed and the MRC's effect will then kick in?

Yes.

> Will MRC be "active" for the rest of the game or does the vote
> have to be called the same round as MRC is played?

For the rest of the game.

One of the best uses for Malkavian Rider Clause is to set
yourself up for a Dramatic Upheaval or Kindred Restructure
when someone across the table is about to fold. Jump in as
their predator with your unbeatable vote, then kill them for
the easy victory point.

http://www.white-wolf.com/VTES/Cardlist_M.html#Malkavian_Rider_Clause

Malkavian Rider Clause [AH]
Cardtype: Reaction
Clan: Malkavian
Cost: 1 blood
Only usable during a <referendum> before voting occurs.
If the <referendum> passes, then the next <referendum>
you successfully call passes automatically.

Carpe Noctem.

LSJ (or anyone who knows for sure) - Can the next referendum
you call be a bloodhunt vote? Charming Lobby has a ruling
(TOM 19950921) that a bloodhunt vote "does not qualify"
(presumably for the second, auto-passing vote, since it seems
obvious that you couldn't call a bloodhunt with the first vote),
but I'm not sure whether that should be carried over to the
Malkavian Rider Clause as a "general rule" that bloodhunt
referenda can't be affected by cards played by minions. (or
something like that.)

Also, I seem to remember reading not too long ago that pre-
Sabbat War) cards that use the phrase "during a political
action" are not usable during a bloodhunt referendum - because

it's not an action - but the piece in the Sabbat War rulebook
that says that most cards that use the "during a political
action" phrase mean "during a referendum", which would suggest
that they *might* be usable. As examples, Power Structure

lets you tap it to gain votes "during a political action", but
Ventrue Headquarters just says to tap it to gain votes. Does
this mean that Power Structure can't be used during a bloodhunt

referendum, but Ventrue Headquarters can? Or am I just mis-
remembering a bunch of things?

Thanks,

Josh
